voyage.name: The Palace of the Shirvan Shahs
voyage.alt: Shirvanshahs' Palace; Azerbaijani: Şirvanşahlar sarayı, Russian: Дворец Ширваншахов
voyage.price: Foreigners 10 manat, locals 2 manat, 2 manat to take photos
voyage.content: The medieval palace of the Shirvan Shahs is the highlight of the Old City and a must see for any tourist in Baku. The complex contains the main building of the palace, Divanhane, the burial-vaults, the shah's mosque with a minaret, Seyid Yahya Bakuvi's mausoleum, a portal in the east - Murad's gate, a reservoir and the remnants of the bath-house. The main building of the complex was started in 1411 by Shirvanshah She

voyage.name: Saray Mosque
voyage.alt: Palatial mosque, Shahs-khans mosque, Azerbaijani: Saray məscidi, Russian: Дворцовая мечеть
voyage.content: Plan of the mosque is rectangular. There is a small hall, small prayer room for women and serving rooms. The northern portal, rotated to a burial vault of Shirvanshahs is more solemn than the eastern one. The latter, which was coming down to underground exit, was intended for habitants of the palace. - Interior. Two-tier windowed prayer room is covered with cupola with spherical sails. Mihrab is located in the southe

voyage.name: Maiden's Tower
voyage.content: This mysterious and eccentric tower was built somewhere between the 7th and 12th centuries and may have served as a fire beacon, defensive fortification, astronomical observatory, or Zoroastrian temple.The tower, which is Baku's most distinguished landmark, described as the "most majestic and mysterious monument of Baku, the Gyz Galasy", built on a solid rock foundation, demonstrates right on the coast line, a fusion

voyage.name: Fortress walls and towers
voyage.content: Built in 11th–12th centuries.

voyage.name: Bukhara Caravanserai
voyage.content: In late 15th century

voyage.name: Hajji Gayyib bathhouse
voyage.content: Built in 15th century. Intake portal of the bathhouse is rectangular-shaped. The bathhouse complex is divided into 3 groups: dressing-room, changing room and a bathing area. The dressing and changing rooms have octagonal halls, surrounded by small rooms. Vaults and domes have various figured outlines and were implemented thoroughly. There is a pool with warm and cold water in the centre of the hall. Floors are covere

voyage.name: Agha Mikayil bathhouse
voyage.alt: Hacı Ağa Mikayıl Hamami, Баня Ага-Микаила

voyage.name: Small Caravansaray
voyage.alt: Khan's caravansaray" (KİÇİK karvansaray, "Xan karvansarayı", Ханский караван-сарай
voyage.content: Built in 1500s.

voyage.name: Molla Ahmad's mosque
voyage.alt: Molla Əhməd məscidi, Мечеть Молла Ахмеда
voyage.content: Built in 1290s.

voyage.name: Two-Storeyed Caravansaray
voyage.content: Constructed in the 17th century.

voyage.name: Hadji Bani (Hajji) mosque
voyage.alt: Hacı Bani məscidi, Мечеть Гаджи Бани
voyage.content: This was constructed by the architect Hadji Bani in the 16th century.

voyage.name: "Chin" mosque
voyage.alt: True mosque, Çin məscidi, Чин мечеть
voyage.content: Constructed in 1375.

voyage.name: Gasim-bek bath
voyage.content: Constructed in the 17th century near the Salyan door (gate).

voyage.name: Madrasah-mosque
voyage.content: The chapel constructed in the 15th century in the yard of Jame mosque

voyage.name: Seyed Yahya mosque
voyage.alt: Seyid Yahya Murtuza mosque, Мечеть Сеид Яхья
voyage.content: Constructed in the early 17th century.

voyage.name: Jame mosque and minaret remains
voyage.alt: Emir Sharaf-ad-din Mahmud mosque and minaret, Mosque Cum, Джума мечеть, Azerbaijani: Cümə məscidi
voyage.content: Founded in 1309-10. The mosque was repeatedly reconstructed during its existence. A new Friday Mosque was constructed on the old mosque's site, with the support of the Baku merchant Haji Shikhlali Dadashov, in 1899. A Zoroastrian temple was located on the site of the two mosques. A minaret, constructed in 1437, adjoins Friday Mosque.

voyage.name: Gileyli mosque
voyage.content: Built in 1309, rebuilt 1800s

voyage.name: Sultan oglu Sultan Sheikh Ibrahim mosque
voyage.alt: Sheikh Ibrahim mosque, Мечеть Шейха Ибрагима
voyage.content: Built in 1415-16.

voyage.name: Muhammad Mosque
voyage.content: This mosque was built in the 11th century in Icheri Sheher, Baku. The mosque is also known as Siniggala, for the name of its minaret – Siniggala ("damaged tower"). The mosque acquired its second name in 1723, when a squadron of the Russian army, consisting of 15 warships and led by Admiral Matyushkin, approached the city and demanded its surrender. Russian warships began to bomb the city after its refusal. One of the

voyage.name: Khidir mosque
voyage.content: Built in the 1300s.

voyage.name: Khanlarov mosque
voyage.content: Built in the late 19th century.

voyage.name: Tetragonal tower
voyage.content: In the northern mid-part of the fortress wall.

voyage.name: Takiya
voyage.content: A chapel for dervishes constructed in the 13th century.

voyage.name: Mosque of the Martyrs
voyage.content: This is a mosque, near the Martyrs' Lane. It was built in the beginning of 1990s with assistance of the Turkish government. The mosque is used as an official residence of the religious attaché of the Turkish embassy. It opened in 2009. The 154th ayah from Al-Baqara chapter of Quran is written on the façade of the mosque in Arabic and Turkish: "Do not say "Dead!" about those, who died for the sake of Allah. No, they a

voyage.name: Taza Pir Mosque
voyage.content: This is a mosque with two minarets. Its construction began in 1905 and was finished by 1914. The idea for the mosque as well as its financing was provided by an Azeri philanthropist, a female, Nabat Khanum Ashurbeyov (Ashurbeyli) - Architecture. The interior of the mosque has an area of 1,400 m² and is decorated with ornaments of painting schools of Azerbaijan and with samples from eastern ornaments. The height of th

voyage.name: Saint Gregory the Illuminator's Church
voyage.alt: Azerbaijani: Bakı Erməni Kilsəsi, Armenian: Սուրբ Գրիգոր Լուսաւորիչի Եկեղեցի – Surp Grigor Lusavorichi Yekeghetsi
voyage.hours: no longer open to the public.
voyage.content: Built in 1887. Now a government building.

voyage.name: Holy Myrrhbearers Cathedral / Russian Orthodox Church
voyage.alt: Russian: Кафедральный Собор Святых Жён-Мироносиц; Azeri: Müqəddəs Mürdaşıyan Zənənlər Başkilsəsi
voyage.content: This Russian Orthodox cathedral was founded in 1909. Hit by a Russian missile in 1990, it was reconstructed and reopened in 2001. It holds a shrine of the apostle St. Bartholomew.

voyage.name: Former Church of the Saviour
voyage.alt: German: Erlöserkirche, German Kapellhaus, Azeri:Xilaskar Kilsəsi
voyage.address: Dilara Aliyeva and 28 May Street (ул. 28 Мая) cnr
voyage.content: Built with a German donation. This was a Lutheran church, opened in 1899. Now it is a concert hall. The Gothic style church features a portal crowned with a decorated pediment. In 1898, a 213-kg gilded cross was raised atop the church. In early 1899 a bell and an organ were installed.

voyage.name: Church of Michael the Archangel
voyage.alt: Russian: Михайло-Архангельский храм; Azerbaijani: Mixayil Arxangel kilsəsi; Flotskaya, Church of the Fleet
voyage.content: This is a Russian Orthodox church. It was founded in 1850.

voyage.name: Church of the Virgin Mary's Immaculate Conception
voyage.alt: Azerbaijani: Müqəddəs Bakirə Məryəm kilsəsi, Russian: Церковь Непорочного Зачатия Пресвятой Девы Марии
voyage.content: This is a Catholic church. It was built in 2006.

voyage.name: National Art Museum of Azerbaijan
voyage.content: The museum consists of two adjacent buildings. The museum's collection includes over 15,000 artworks. There are over 3,000 items in 60 rooms on permanent display. Seven of the rooms in the first building feature European art, and ten rooms feature Russian art. European art includes works of Italian, French, Dutch/Flemish, German and Polish painters. - The second edifice built in 1885 houses Eastern art, represented p

voyage.name: National Museum of History of Azerbaijan
voyage.alt: Taghiyev History Museum, Azerbaijani: Azərbaycan Tarix Muzeyi, Russian: Музей истории Азербайджана
voyage.hours: Mon-Sat 11:00-18:00, first Mon of every month closed (– cleanup day)
voyage.content: The museum was built in 1893–1902. The Italian Renaissance-style mansion is immense and occupies an entire city block. There are four floors in some parts of the building. It was designed by Polish architect Józef Gosławski. On the second floor of Taghiyev's residence, side-by-side there are two major ballrooms. One is based on Oriental designs (Mauritanian style) and the other, on Western design. The Oriental Room h

voyage.name: Azerbaijan Carpet Museum
voyage.alt: State Museum of Azerbaijan Carpet and Applied Art
voyage.content: The museum hosts a wide range of carpets, both old and new. It moved to its current location in 2014 (on the waterfront). The building itself is shaped as a carpet.

voyage.name: Heydar Aliyev Center
voyage.alt: Heydər Əliyev Mərkəzi, Центр Гейдара Алиева
voyage.content: This is a 64,103 m² building complex designed by Iraqi-British architect Zaha Hadid and noted for its distinctive architecture and flowing, curved style that eschews sharp angles. The Heydar Aliyev Center represents a fluid form which emerges by the folding of the landscape's natural topography and by the wrapping of individual functions of the Center. All functions of the Center, together with entrances, are represe

voyage.name: Stone Museum
voyage.content: An old factory transformed into a stone exhibition, with samples and replicas from Gobustan and other stone carvings in the region. Free English-speaking guide.

voyage.name: Art exhibition
voyage.content: On a reformed old factory, two free art exhibitions in two adjacent buildings. Free English-speaking guide.

voyage.name: Baku Boulevard
voyage.content: Seaside promenade with museums, parks, cafes, restaurants, and other attractions.

voyage.name: Fountain Square
voyage.content: This is a downtown pedestrian street in the center of Baku lined with shops, hotels and restaurants. It is a public gathering place, especially after business hours and during the weekend. It hosts public festivals, shows and celebrations.

voyage.name: Nizami (Torgovaya) St
voyage.content: This is a large pedestrian and shopping street in downtown Baku, named after the famed classical poet Nizami Ganjavi. Nizami Street is home to various outlets, from banks to fashion stores and is one of the most expensive streets in the world. The street also accommodates the embassies. - Buildings are mostly from the late 19th-early 20th century, 1950s-1970s and a modern period. Most of the buildings, constructed in

voyage.name: Oil Rocks
voyage.content: Neft Daşları began operations in 1949, thus becoming the first offshore oil platform in the world. Later, using the intentionally sunk ships as its foundation, an artificial archipelago has grown around it, interconnected by an extensive network of bridges and supporting a full-sized town inhabited by about 2,000 people. It's possible to visit the oil rock complex, but you should get a permit from the State Oil Compa

voyage.name: National Flag Square
voyage.content: A large city square.

voyage.name: Alley of Honor
voyage.content: This is a public cemetery and memorial in Baku, Azerbaijan. The Alley includes burials of famed Azerbaijanis and Azerbaijan-affiliated expatriates, including several Presidents, scientists and artists. There are 242 burials in total.

voyage.name: Martyrs' Lane
voyage.alt: Alley of Martyrs or Şəhidlər Xiyabanı (transliterated to Shehidler Khiyabani)
voyage.content: Formerly the Kirov Park, it's a cemetery and memorial in Baku, dedicated to those killed by the Soviet Army during Black January and to those killed later in the Nagorno-Karabakh War.

voyage.name: International Mugham Center of Azerbaijan
voyage.alt: Beynəlxalq Muğam Mərkəzi, Международный центр мугама
voyage.content: This is the center of Azerbaijani arts and music dedicated to promote, preserve and popularize the Azerbaijani music genre Mugam. The center covers 7,500 m² and has 3 stories. The design of the building was based on elements and shapes of Tar, an Azerbaijani musical instrument used in performing Mugham. The concert hall has a capacity of 350 people. The center also has a club, restaurant, study halls and record studi

voyage.name: Magomayev Azerbaijan State Philharmonic Hall
voyage.content: Built in 1912 and inspired by the Monte Carlo Casino. Houses the Azerbaijan State Symphony Orchestra among others.

voyage.name: Palace of Happiness
voyage.alt: Azerbaijani: Səadət Sarayı, Palace of Marriage former Mukhtarov Palace
voyage.content: This is a historic building in the center of Baku, Azerbaijan, built in Neo-Gothic style in 1912. The building was built by an Azerbaijani Oil Baron Murtuza Mukhtarov for his wife Lisa. The designer was the Polish architect Józef Plośko. After Sovietization in 1920 the building was given to the Club of Liberated Turkic Women, after which it functioned as the Shirvanshahs' Museum. During the existence of Azerbaijan SS

voyage.name: Gulustan Palace
voyage.alt: Azerbaijani: Gülüstan sarayı, Gulustan Wedding Palace Complex
voyage.content: The complex during the Soviet era is the main state convention center of the Azerbaijani government. From here overlooking the city of Baku and Baku Bay. The palace hosts formal events of governmental and non-governmental organizations. It is notable for having hosted such important events as the Contract of the Century and other significant oil and gas contracts, signing of TRACECA project, the wedding of Leyla Aliy

voyage.name: Ismailiyya building
voyage.content: This is a historical building serves as the Presidium of the Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan. - The palace was constructed in 1913, for the Muslim Charity Society by Józef Plośko, funded by millionaire Musa Naghiyev in commemoration of his deceased son Ismayil, and was named Ismailiyya after him. The building was constructed in Venetian Gothic style.

voyage.name: Baku TV Tower
voyage.content: Built in 1996, is a free-standing concrete telecommunications tower. With a height of 310 m, it is the tallest structure in Azerbaijan and the tallest reinforced concrete building in Caucasus. The tower is one of the most prominent hallmarks of Baku. - A rotating restaurant on the 62nd floor (175 m) of Azeri TV Tower was opened in 2008. Friendly staff.

voyage.name: Flame Towers
voyage.content: These are the tallest skyscrapers in Baku, Azerbaijan with a height of 190 m (620 ft). They consist of apartments, a hotel and office blocks. The estimated cost of Flame Towers was around US$350 million. Construction began in 2007, with completion in 2012. The facades of the three Flame Towers are turned into gigantic display screens with the use of more than 10,000 high-power LED luminaires, supplied by the Osram su

voyage.name: Oil Pump Fields
voyage.content: The famous oil pump fields from the opening scene of the James Bond picture The World is Not Enough.

voyage.name: Bibi-Heybat Mosque
voyage.content: This is a historical mosque built in the 1990s, and is a recreation of the mosque with the same name built in the 13th century by Shirvanshah Farrukhzad II Ibn Ahsitan II, which was completely destroyed by the Bolsheviks in 1936.The Bibi-Heybat Mosque includes the tomb of Ukeyma Khanum (a descendant of the Prophet Muhammad), and today is the spiritual center for the Muslims of the region and one of the major monument

voyage.name: Philharmonic Fountain Park
voyage.content: A charming park with fountains and kiosks you can pass through when going to the boulevard from the Metro.

voyage.name: Mud Volcano which is supposed to be 15 km north of Baku city centre
Boat tours of Baku
voyage.content: Offered from the Baku Blvd. Lasts 40 minutes.

voyage.name: Pantomima theatre
voyage.content: Offered from the Baku Blvd. Lasts 40 minutes.

voyage.name: Baku Funicular Railroad
voyage.content: Runs from the square on Neftchilar Avenue up to the Alley of the Marytrs.

voyage.name: Baku Entertainment Center
voyage.content: Baku Entertainment center has been around for more than half a decade. It has a shopping center, bowling alley certified by the AMF, health club, conference venue with a capacity of 350 people, and various restaurants and clubs.

voyage.name: Mini-Venice
voyage.content: A charming little complex of man-made waterways accessible on a boat. There are also some restaurants in the immediate proximity. The ticket booth is 10-15 meters to the right when coming from the north. It is cheap but the signage to the ticket booth is lacking.

voyage.name: Football
voyage.content: The men's national team play soccer at Tofiq Bahramov Stadium, capacity 31,000. Five clubs in the city play in the Premier League, Azerbaijan's top tier.

voyage.name: Azersun stadium
voyage.content: Qarabağ FK. Capacity 5,800.

voyage.name: ASK Arena
voyage.content: Keşla FK (formerly Inter Baku). Capacity 8,200.

voyage.name: Bakcell Arena
voyage.content: Neftçi. Capacity 11,000.

voyage.name: Zira Olympic sports complex
voyage.content: Zira FK

voyage.name: Asco Arena
voyage.content: Sabail FK.

voyage.name: Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium
voyage.content: As the previous stadia are small by European standards, big club games may transfer to this stadium. E.g. a host venue for the Euro 2020 tournament.

voyage.name: Baku Olympic Stadium
voyage.content: This also hosts big games, such as the 2019 UEFA Europa League Finals.

voyage.name: Baku City Circuit
voyage.content: A 6 km on-street motor-racing circuit along the shore used for Formula One and other events. The next F1 races are 25-27 Sept 2026 then on 24-26 Sep 2027.

voyage.name: Hamam Mehellesi
voyage.price: 10 manat and they offer two types of service, hise (skin peel) for 15 manat, and massage for 20 manat
voyage.content: This is the oldest public bath in Baku, located near the Icharishahar metro station, inside the old city. Mondays and Fridays are reserved for women, the rest of the days are only for men.

voyage.name: Aga Mikayil Bath House (XVIII century hamami)
voyage.content: Sauna and pools, nice ambiance.

voyage.name: Naftalan Bath
voyage.price: 20 manat for medical checkup, 20 manat for one oil bath
voyage.content: Naftalan, a city close to Ganja, is famous for oil baths. However you can also get an oil treatment in Baku, with imported Naftalan oil. It's like a small hospital and not very recreational. However it's great fun and positively strange to dip for 15 min into hot crude oil. Decide for yourself whether this is safe and healthy.

voyage.name: The Spa at Park Hyatt Baku
voyage.address: Park Hyatt Baku Hotel, 1033 Izmir St

voyage.name: Teze Bey Hamami
voyage.content: Public baths (hamamlar). This men-only public bath is in the old town and offers Finnish and Turkish baths, etc., so it may be a bit pricier than its competitors.

voyage.name: AF Beach Club
voyage.content: This complex has 5 swimming pools, fast food, a restaurant with cooks from Azerbaijan and Europe, a disco, a game hall, Wi-Fi, water sports, beach volley, beach football, entertainment, and a professional animation team.

voyage.name: Amburan Beach Club
voyage.content: This complex has a 3 swimming pools, fast food outlets, a restaurant with cooks from Azerbaijan and Europe, a disco, a game hall, Wi-Fi, water sports, beach volley, beach football, entertainment, and a professional animation team.

voyage.name: Baku Jazz Festival
voyage.price: Tickets can be purchased from Baku Jazz Center, 19 Rashid Behbudov St or by phone.
voyage.content: Organised by the famous saxophonist and Baku resident Rain Sultanov to showcase Azerbaijan's love of jazz which grew during the Soviet era when it was banned by the authorities. Features acts from around the world, the annual festival lasts for a week, and will run from 7–14 June.

voyage.name: Mega Memi
voyage.content: A chain for second-hand clothes, which has a few outlets around Baku, offering a good range of second-hand clothes at fairly low prices (1.5-manat scarf, 5-manat shirt, etc.).

voyage.name: Chiraq bookstore
voyage.content: Phrasebooks, maps and guides can be found here.

voyage.name: Taza Bazaar
voyage.content: A huge famous food and spice market. Nonetheless, very much a market for the locals rather than tourists. Haggle to your heart's content (best to know a couple of phrases in Russian for this one).

voyage.name: Sabunchu Flea Market
voyage.content: A huge flea market next to some oil fields, seems to be mainly Azerbaijani families selling off old stuff from their homes. Some great finds to be had but it does take a while to sift through all the mounds of odd clothing and random bits of scrap metal. Women visiting alone should be more cautious than in central Baku, foreigners attract attention here and being followed isn't unheard of.

voyage.name: AF MALL
voyage.address: in the heart of the city just off the Torgovaya on Samed Vurgun St 34
voyage.content: This mall has many trendy shops, a summer lounge with a tropical garden and a rooftop pool.

voyage.name: Park Bulvar Shopping Mall
voyage.address: Along the boulevard, right across Park Inn Hotel
voyage.content: This mall has many trendy shops, a cinema, a planetarium, a bowling alley and many cozy cafes. There are many famous fast food chains, including KFC and Sbarro.

voyage.name: Half Way Inn
voyage.content: International cuisine.

voyage.name: Lavas Bistro / Fasali Cafe
voyage.price: 3 manat for a kebab/pancake which will completely fill you up
voyage.content: Two take-away places, one next to the other, run by the same people. Do a wide range of usual Azeri/Turkish take-away food - but good quality, very popular with the locals, expect to queue!

voyage.name: Anadolu
voyage.content: Turkish/European restaurant.

voyage.name: Firuze Restaurant
voyage.content: Serves excellent, very filling Piti. .

voyage.name: Tonqal Restoranı
voyage.content: The various meat dishes include kebabs and organ-meat-based delicacies.

voyage.name: Lido
voyage.content: European and Azeri cuisine.

voyage.name: Masal
voyage.content: Kebabs, or, if you prefer, flatbreads and pizza.

voyage.name: Mugam Club
voyage.content: European and Azeri cuisine.

voyage.name: Namli Kebab
voyage.content: Turkish and Azeri cuisine.

voyage.name: U Dali
voyage.content: Georgian cuisine.

voyage.name: Gazelli Cafe
voyage.content: European cafe that does up some stylish and tasteful plates.

voyage.name: Dolce Vita
voyage.content: Italian restaurant. Offerings include a duck or meatball salad.

voyage.name: Grand Hotel Europe
voyage.content: International cuisine.

voyage.name: Cafe City Sahil
voyage.content: Mixed cuisine cafe.

voyage.name: Mexicana Baku
voyage.content: Tacos and Mexican cuisine

voyage.name: Park Inn's Glory Restaurant
voyage.content: Views of the skyline and perhaps the Caspian Sea are paired with European cuisine.

voyage.name: Pizza Holiday
voyage.content: An Azeri pizza and Italian-cuisine chain

voyage.name: Paris Bistro
voyage.content: French cuisine

voyage.name: Buddha Bar Baku
voyage.address: Azadliq Square, JW Marriott Absheron 3rd floor
voyage.content: Fusion Cuisine, everything is done up with quite a bit of class at this Marriott venue.

voyage.name: Maharaja
voyage.content: Indian and Pakistani food, with the possibility of a buffet.

voyage.name: Taj Mahal Indian Restaurant
voyage.content: Similar to other one, with buffet at times.

voyage.name: Chinar
voyage.content: Pan-Asian cuisine, modern tea house and late night cocktail bar.

voyage.name: Mezzo
voyage.content: Italian wine and cuisine in a dining room overlooking the hotel's garden.

voyage.name: Terrace Garden
voyage.content: Another opportunity to feast your eyes on the Baku scene while you dine on European and Azeri cuisine.

voyage.name: Azza Cafe
voyage.content: They bake cakes aside from doing coffee.

voyage.name: Baku Roasting Company
voyage.content: Here you can get a nice roast and maybe an egg burrito type of thing as well.

voyage.name: Chocolates Cafe Baku
voyage.content: Not just coffee and chocolatey desserts, but sandwiches too.

voyage.name: The Lounge & Bar
voyage.content: A distinguished place to have a drink

voyage.name: Finnegan's
voyage.content: Next to History Museum. Free wifi. Good beer prices and Happy Hour offers. Ridiculously expensive wine, however. It doesn't serve Guinness. April 2016.

voyage.name: 360 Bar
voyage.content: Here you can have a refreshment from atop the Hilton hotel tower, or, if you prefer to stay more grounded, there is also the Sugar Lounge below offering tea, baklava and vodka.

voyage.name: Victor's Bar
voyage.content: Classy cocktails

voyage.name: The Phoenix Bar
voyage.content: Lots of booze on hand here.

voyage.name: Hops Pub Baku
voyage.content: Good for socializing and a game of snooker or pool.

voyage.name: Caledonia Bar
voyage.content: Offers a familiar pub atmosphere with photos and memorabilia from Scotland. Screens for watching sporting events.

voyage.name: Otto Club
voyage.content: Club for dancing on the weekend. Make sure to arrive after midnight if you don't want to be alone. Expect electro and dance music from a DJ as you would expect in European countries

voyage.name: Caspian Hostel
voyage.content: Great location in the Old Town. 2 dorm rooms and 1 private room.

voyage.name: Guest House Inn
voyage.price: Room with TV, fridge, private bathroom, hot water 60 manat per person
voyage.content: This hotel is in the center of Old Town in a calm area, 10 minutes on foot to the nearest metro station, very friendly staff.

voyage.name: Cheeky Carabao Backpackers Hostel
voyage.content: Well located upbeat hostel with Ping pong, Wii, movies on the projector, and more. Very clean has kitchen, dorms, privates, laundry service.

voyage.name: Altstadt Hotel
voyage.address: Mammedyarov str. 3/2A (Ilyas Efendiyev str.3/2A), Icheri Sheher
voyage.content: A "better" two-star hotel, with buffet breakfast, spotless private facilities, A/C, Wi-Fi, TV. Offers excursions, helps with visas if necessary. Run by the very friendly Mr. Elmin (Beatles fan) who is always happy to give info and help guests.

voyage.name: Consul Hotel
voyage.content: This is a hotel option in the Genclik district.

voyage.name: Days Hotel Baku
voyage.content: 15 minutes' drive from the Heydar Aliyev International Airport and 10 minutes from the city center. 102 rooms with Wi-fi Internet access, one international restaurant, one lounge-bar and two conference rooms.

voyage.name: Diplomat Hotel
voyage.content: Centrally located. Credit cards accepted.

voyage.name: Holiday Inn Baku Airport
voyage.content: Facilities include a kids stay and eat free program, Internet access in all rooms, various restaurants, complimentary shuttle to downtown and a spa.

voyage.name: Park Inn by Radisson Baku Hotel
voyage.content: Fully-equipped business centre, restaurant, bar and coffee shop, five modern conference rooms and an elegant ballroom with a large foyer. Also offers Wi-Fi in all guest rooms, gift shop, free airport shuttle, 24-hour room service, workout room, open parking facilities, 24-hour concierge.

voyage.name: Rigs Hotel
voyage.content: 24 rooms

voyage.name: AF Hotel Aqua Park
voyage.price: From 80 manat for a standard double room up to 500 manat for a presidential
voyage.content: There have been complaints with this hotel – please check online reviews.AF Hotel is the largest hotel and resort in the Caucasus. This complex houses pools, saunas, salons, water slides, an entertainment center, and hotel facilities.

voyage.name: Amburan Beach Club
voyage.content: This complex has a 3 swimming pool, fast food outlets, a restaurant with cooks from Azerbaijan and Europe, a disco, a game hall, Wi-Fi Internet, water sports, beach volley, beach football, entertainment, and a professional animation team.

voyage.name: Crescent Beach Hotel
voyage.content: This complex has an indoor and outdoor pool, beach front, bar, and tourism services. High-speed Wi-Fi zone covering 10 hotel buildings, the hotel yard, restaurant, bars and beach. Please contact hotel reception.

voyage.name: Excelsior Hotel Baku
voyage.price: The rate per night range from US$250-2,450, but will be converted to manat at the hotel's rate
voyage.content: With a 5-star rating, the Excelsior Hotel is one of the nicest hotels in Baku.

voyage.name: Hyatt Regency Baku
voyage.content: Services include high-speed Internet access, chauffeur-driven limousine rental, hotel shops, Wi-Fi, a business center, The Grill, Gourmet Shop, Beluga Bar, Club Oasis Fitness Center, swimming pools, tennis courts, squash courts, a ballroom, 10 meeting rooms, 2 boardrooms, and pre-function and social function space.

voyage.name: Park Hyatt Baku
voyage.content: 5-star hotel adjacent to a comprehensive meeting & conference centre. Club lounge for free continental breakfast, evening cocktails and boardroom access.
